items.title: Bitcoin in 'Wait and See Mode'–And That Might Be a Good Thing
items.summary: The crypto market has been quiet as of late. Market analysts think that might actually be a good sign and that a bull market might be near.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $635M as October slides back into the red
items.summary: Thursday's withdrawals ended a three-day inflow streak and left US spot Bitcoin ETFs with $175 million in net outflows for October.

items.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
items.summary: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

items.title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100
items.summary: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $81,500 as tech stock sell-off spreads to Asian equities
items.summary: The Wall Street sell-off extended to Asian equities on Friday morning, with South Korea's Kospi down 2.3% and Japan's Nikkei 225 down 1.6%.

items.title: Switzerland's first retail spot Bitcoin ETF targets November launch
items.summary: BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.

items.summary: The alleged fraudster tried to run away with nearly 62,000 bitcoins. This post China Moves to Confiscate $5 Billion in Bitcoin From Fraudster Who Fled to UK: Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.
